traits.name: Human versatility
traits.effect: Choose one bonus Savvy skill, one extra level of Expertise in a skill, and one additional Talent whose requirements you meet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.effect: Regional cultural language 70 and Low Vestrian 20. Old Vestrians may instead choose Low Vestrian 70 and High Vestrian 20.

traits.name: Dwarven craft
traits.effect: Locks & Traps is a bonus Savvy skill. Reduce the SL requirement of extended Craft: Practical and Craft: Artistic rolls by 2.

traits.name: Hardy, dour
traits.effect: Endurance +10; Lethality Level +1; Inspire −10.

traits.name: Exclusive Talent
traits.effect: May acquire Dwarven Swordsinger.

traits.name: Languages
traits.effect: Kharzhad 70; Low Vestrian 20.

traits.name: Hardy outcast
traits.effect: Start with Toughness 1; Endurance is a bonus Savvy skill; Willpower −10. Initial social encounters may be uneasy because strangers commonly assume you are a monster.

traits.name: Exclusive Talent
traits.effect: May acquire Blood-Fury.

traits.name: Languages
traits.effect: Orcish 70; Low Vestrian 20.

traits.name: Large and strong
traits.effect: Start with Toughness 1 and Death Threshold 22. Might +10; apply the extra +20 per Size difference when Grappling. Inventory ENC maximum 8.

traits.name: Awkward and oversized
traits.effect: Stealth −20; Athletics −20; Melee: Light −20. Medium and Large shields only. No Civilized background; cannot become a Spellweaver or Fade.

traits.name: Armour and Breaking
traits.effect: Cannot normally wear men's reinforced leather, mail, scale or plate. If worn, treat as untrained and suffer −20 to Willpower. Bone armour is an option. A critical failure after spending Resolve triggers the Breaking; consult the race entry for its combat and recovery procedure.

traits.name: Exclusive Talent
traits.effect: May acquire Devouring Maw.

traits.name: Languages
traits.effect: Tusker 70; Low Vestrian 20.

traits.name: Weave affinity
traits.effect: If you have Patterned in the Weave, choose one Bind for +10. Otherwise, gain +10 on opposed rolls against Weave Magic.

traits.name: Fragile heritage
traits.effect: Stealth −10; Insight −10. Toughness can never exceed 2. Cannot choose Civilized: Urban.

traits.name: Bonus Savvy
traits.effect: Choose one: Melee: Light, Missile, Ancient Lore, Arcana, or Naturewise.

traits.name: Ancestor Communion
traits.effect: Touch an Elven memory stone and pass a Hard (−20) Willpower roll to access its memories; higher SLs improve the outcome.

traits.name: Exclusive Talent
traits.effect: May acquire Whispered Inheritance.

traits.name: Languages
traits.effect: Fionnan (Low Court) 70; Low Vestrian 20.

traits.name: Human traits
traits.effect: Gain all Human traits, including their extra Savvy skill, Expertise level and eligible Talent.

traits.name: Dark Fae-wise
traits.effect: Start with Dark Fae-wise 20. Improving it requires a session in the physical presence of another Replaced.

traits.name: Fae captivity
traits.effect: Cannot be a Spellweaver or Fade. Gain Hunted by the Queen for free; may acquire the exclusive Thornmark Talent.

traits.name: Languages
traits.effect: Regional cultural language 70; Low Vestrian 20.
